purpose: Durable, compact state for the Lead ChatGPT reasoning/review layer. This is routing and continuity context, not trading evidence and not a replacement for current code/SQLite/authoritative plans.

north_star.business_goal: Continuously improve genuine forward, executable, cost-adjusted, risk-adjusted meme-token profitability without using future data or manufacturing trade count.
north_star.engineering_translation: Improve the full chain Source/Token discovery -> Event<->Token evidence -> exact CA/canonical mapping -> executable Decision -> realistic Paper execution -> fixed-horizon learning, while controlling false positives, ambiguity, costs and tail risk.
north_star.anti_proxy_rule: More UI, more Agent calls, more Decisions, more Paper trades, historical winners, or raw backtest return are not substitutes for forward net-EV evidence.

authority_order: latest explicit user instruction and safety constraints, whether expressed in the GXH ChatGPT project chats or the designated Codex thread/history

when user-intent sources appear to conflict: explicit supersession and later/specific instructions override older/general ones; otherwise preserve both and record a conflict instead of silently dropping either
current code, r6 SQLite, tests and running-process facts are authoritative for current implementation/runtime facts
CHATGPT/Codex/reviewer proposals only after verification and promotion

drift_guard.mandatory_question_before_scope_change: Which currently observed end-to-end profitability bottleneck will this action change?
drift_guard.if_no_clear_answer: Do not displace the active cycle. Preserve the idea in the governed idea lane instead.
drift_guard.scope_change_rule: A supplementary request or attractive idea changes active scope only when it is explicitly superseding a frozen/current instruction or is promoted into CURRENT_OBJECTIVE_AND_PLAN.md / REQUIREMENT_LEDGER.md under the existing PROMOTE_NOW rule.
drift_guard.local_optimum_warning: Codex's minimal-action policy is useful for implementation, but every local task remains subordinate to the active project objective and cycle.

coordination_topology.lead_chatgpt_role: Objective keeper; deep research, reasoning, causal/statistical review, trading-economics review, architecture challenge, alternative-path discovery, cross-review synthesis and drift detection.
coordination_topology.reviewers: Use distinct read-only roles only at material architecture/strategy/experiment/deployment gates; they report to Lead ChatGPT, not as competing writers.

memory_policy.rule: All project-relevant Lead ChatGPT facts, conclusions, decisions, hypotheses, contradictions, open questions and handoffs that need to survive chat/context loss are distilled to files under E:/memeTrader.
memory_policy.raw_private_reasoning: Do not persist private chain-of-thought. Persist decision-relevant conclusions, evidence pointers, uncertainty and falsifiable next checks instead.

communication_design.primary: Event-driven direct bidirectional messaging between the exact Codex execution thread and designated Lead ChatGPT using Codex Desktop's own codex_app thread-management surface. User-authorized urgent correction may be sent as a priority steer to the existing thread without creating a second writer.
communication_design.fallback: Common Space + durable mailbox + fast pointer with attention_required provide durable visibility/recovery when direct delivery is unavailable; they are not evidence that a realtime message was delivered.
communication_design.realtime_meaning: Low-latency event-driven collaboration at decision points, material evidence changes, natural samples and deploy/restart gates; not continuous token-burning heartbeat chatter.
communication_design.anti_forgetting_layer: A global Codex hooks.json points to E:/memeTrader/scripts/codex_project_context_guard.cmd. The guard injects compact E:-resident context on every UserPromptSubmit and on SessionStart only for resume/compact, filtered to memeTrader/GXH mirror cwd. It also surfaces pending attention_required alerts.
communication_design.common_space_design: Detailed bilateral research/challenge lives in E:/memeTrader/docs/PROJECT_CONTEXT/COMMON_SPACE with side-owned notes and immutable directional alert cards. Realtime messages are short doorbells pointing to Common Space; accepted execution state still belongs to Objective/Requirement/Sync authority.
communication_design.direct_thread_injection_boundary: Direct ChatGPT->Codex delivery is now verified through the already-running Codex Desktop codex_app tool surface, not a competing Codex writer. Delivery claims require a unique MESSAGE_ID plus target-thread verification; processing claims additionally require explicit ACK/REPLY_TO. Do not fall back to codex exec resume while the main thread owns the writer lock.
